# `scheduler.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
threshold_percent = 75
```

[d0100] error | PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED | version 4.x
# PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.
